{{Current events|year=2026|month=07|day=28|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza peace plan]]
***A [[Hamas]] delegation visits [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]], to resume negotiations on the implementation of the next phase of its [[ceasefire]] with [[Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-903922 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***Emergency lawyers report that recent [[airstrike]]s have targeted multiple locations in [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], including a [[Water supply in Sudan|water station]] and civilian vehicles, killing dozens of civilians. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316727 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

''' Arts and culture'''
*The longlist for the [[2026 Booker Prize]] is announced. [https://www.theguardian.com/books/2026/jul/28/previous-winners-douglas-stuart-and-marlon-james-lead-a-brit-heavy-booker-prize-longlist (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Kumamoto earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|7.1}} earthquake strikes central [[Kumamoto Prefecture]], [[Japan]], causing a [[Tsunami Warning (Japan)|tsunami alert]] for the western [[Kyushu|Kyūshū]] coast. At least two people have been killed in a shopping mall collapse. [https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/80886 (Kyodo News)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/magnitude-71-earthquake-hits-japans-kyushu-region-jma-says-2026-07-28/ (Reuters)]
*Three more people are rescued from the [[Vietnam]]ese cargo ship {{mv|Khoi Nguyen 18||2}} that sank on Saturday. Fourteen others remain missing with a multinational search still underway. [https://www.thecanadianpressnews.ca/environment/survivors-rise-to-48-with-more-missing-after-vietnamese-ship-sinks-in-south-china-sea/article_4afba6fb-e1d7-52cb-a1cc-ac297ba92f84.html (The Canadian Press)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Apalachee High School shooting]]
**The gunman convicted of carrying out a [[school shooting]] at [[Apalachee High School]] in [[Winder, Georgia|Winder]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]], in 2024, receives four sentences of [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life in prison]] without the possibility of [[parole]]. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/332877/life-in-prison-for-us-teenager-who-shot-dead-4-people-at-school (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[Tatmadaw|military]]-backed [[Pyidaungsu Hluttaw|parliament]] passes a law allowing the [[Capital punishment in Myanmar|death penalty]] when [[coercion]], [[unlawful detention]], torture, or other abuse used to force victims into [[Internet fraud|online scams]] results in death. The law also imposes severe penalties on [[Scam centers in Myanmar|scam-centre]] operators. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260728-myanmar-approves-death-sentence-for-cyberscam-offences (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Taiwan]]ese prosecutors detain an [[Nvidia]] employee in an investigation into alleged smuggling of [[advanced artificial intelligence]] [[Hardware for artificial intelligence|chips]] to [[China]] through [[Forgery|falsified]] [[transport document]]s. Authorities hold seven people over shipments of about 50 [[Supermicro]] [[Supercomputer|servers]] that may violate [[United States New Export Controls on Advanced Computing and Semiconductors to China|U.S. export controls]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260728-taiwan-detains-nvidia-worker-in-chip-smuggling-probe-source-familiar-with-case (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Victorian Labor Party leadership election]]
**In [[Australia]], [[Victoria, Australia|Victorian]] [[Premier of Victoria|premier]] [[Jacinta Allan]] resigns, triggering a [[leadership spill]]. [[Ben Carroll]] is elected unanimously as the new Premier and [[Victorian Labor Party]] leader. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-07-28/ben-carroll-new-victorian-premier-jacinta-allan-successor/106787490 (ABC News Australia)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australias-victoria-state-premier-resigns-ahead-november-election-2026-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Peruvian general election]]
**[[Keiko Fujimori]] is sworn in as [[President of Peru]] after winning the general election in June. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-keiko-fujimori-inauguration-84d08998b1629c95f0383d7b5a7a7f6b (AP)]
